testcase.name: catalog local launch loads the exact cached version and rejects invalid maps [writes-preferences]
a map change is announced once; a status change is not
a member without a seat is listed, and Ready says why it is unavailable
a premade map is uploaded and chosen for the room, then named by the server
a room's teams are named from their alliances, in team order
catalog launch creates the room with its map in the initial request
the server's start notice is shown once in the room chat
